title: Monarch component manifest
description: Every public export of @rookcom/monarch-react with its props, defaults, allowed values, import line, stylesheets and docs page. Generated from the TypeScript declarations by packages/react/scripts/manifest.ts.

tokens.description: The tokens stylesheet every app loads.

scope.description: rook: built for a Rook platform contract (docs/guides/rook-specific-exports.md). Prefer general exports outside Rook.

className.description: Root class of the element the component renders (and forwards its ref to). Public and stable within a minor.

usesClient.description: The module starts with 'use client'. It still renders on the server; React Server Components import it as a client boundary.

clientOnly.description: Deprecated alias of usesClient. It never meant "cannot server-render": every export is server-render safe.

css.description: Stylesheets to import when the app does not load the full styles.css (getting-started §2).

componentCss.description: The smallest alternative: the per-component sheet.

size.description: Size of the component folder's module: minified and gzipped, with package imports external, as last recorded in registry/size-budgets.json. Exports of one folder share it.

values.description: The allowed literal values when the type is a union of literals.
